title: Number of Ways to Earn Points
summary: Given a test with n types of questions, where each type has a specific count and point value, calculate the number of ways to score exactly a target number of points.
statement: Given a test with n types of questions, where each type has a specific count and point value, calculate the number of ways to score exactly a target number of points. The result should be modulo 10^9 + 7. Questions of the same type are indistinguishable.
constraints: Each type [count,marks] supplies up to count indistinguishable questions worth marks points each.
Count choices of quantities by type that total exactly target.
target_time_complexity: O(types times target times maximum count)
hints: Use bounded knapsack DP where ways[score] counts quantity choices after processed types.
For one type, try every used quantity from zero through its count.
Transfer each reachable old score to old+used*marks in a fresh array.
Using a fresh layer prevents reusing a type beyond its bound, and each final quantity vector follows one unique sequence of transitions.
editorial: Using a fresh layer prevents reusing a type beyond its bound, and each final quantity vector follows one unique sequence of transitions.

tests.explanation: Seven different per-type quantity choices total exactly six points.
Taking one question of each type is the only way to score five.
